findings.reason: the node's done-when (same section, :77) requires the pinned spelling to parse, render canonically and round-trip, so as written the node either fails or silently ships a spelling the plan does not name, and the plan must say which it wants (name the operator `argmax_with_respect_to` like the derivative, or accept the fused-prefix spelling).
findings.text: §5 says `argmax` is "like `derivative_with_respect_to`" and that the name "carries the coordinate in the same canonical order, operand first and coordinate last", pinning `argmax_of_deposited_power_with_respect_to_normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate`, but the operand-first form is emitted only for an operator whose fused token literally contains `_with_respect_to_`: `render.py:200-207` partitions `op.op` on `_with_respect_to_` and otherwise falls through to `f"{op.op}_of_{operand}"`, and `parser.py:1078-1084` skips any operator whose `partition("_with_respect_to")` yields an empty relation, so a bare `argmax` indexed operator renders and parses as `argmax_normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_of_deposited_power` and the pinned spelling raises ParseError

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — for the changed units every anchor resolves: `geometry_carriers.yml` exists and `specification.yml` binds `geometric_bases: !include vocabularies/geometry_carriers.yml`; `locus_registry.yml` is the file bound to both `objects` and `positions` (specification.yml:492-495), so §2's "objects vocabulary in `locus_registry.yml`" and its equipment-object placement are correct and each of the six carries `yaml_path: .../locus_registry.yml` in the worklist; `specification.yml` does retain the prefix `device` segment "for parse compatibility only" (specification.yml:56-60, 283-287); `build-grammar` is a declared console entrypoint (specification.yml:11-13); tags `v0.10.1` exists in this tree; and the worklist file §1 cites exists at the stated path.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §2's third bullet is a real negative control that compares the tree against `v0.10.1` (verified empty of vocabulary drift: `git diff --stat v0.10.1 HEAD -- grammar/vocabularies/ specification.yml` prints nothing, so "exactly the 35" is achievable), it names a planted-extra-token arm as well as a planted-removal arm, and §5's second bullet names a planted-removal control on the semantic effect; the s5 spelling defect that bullet 2 measures is scored under `reasoning` because the measure is sound and will fail as written, which is how the defect surfaces.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — neither changed unit writes an evidence file; §2's and §5's measures are suite tests and the drift/planted-token checks, whose logs land on the run's own evidence path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, gate ids, ticket numbers or version tags enter the vocabulary or the semantic-effect member §5 proposes; `argmax`, `OperatorSemanticEffect` and `dimension_transforming` are mechanism names that already exist in the tree.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5's stated canonical order is not the order the indexed-operator machinery renders for a bare operator token, so the spelling its done-when pins does not parse.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 now carries one deliverable, `argmax`'s dimension semantics, with `threshold_crossing` moved to §2, so the earlier bundling of two mechanics belongs to no section; §2 is 35 vocabulary registrations plus the tests that police them.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §2 feeds §3, and §4's `plan-section-depends-on` names both §2 and §5, which is exactly the pair §4 releases ("Once §2 and §5 land"); §5's section block sits at the head of §5 and its `data-id` matches the dependency key.
